name: Liquor
overview: Scripture warns against the dangers of liquor, highlighting that wine and strong drink can deceive and provoke destructive behavior, as seen in Proverbs 20:1 and Isaiah 5:11. Leaders are specifically admonished to abstain from such indulgence to maintain wisdom and honor (Proverbs 31:4). The New Testament reinforces this caution by associating drunkenness with sinful acts that bar one from inheriting God's kingdom (Galatians 5:21) and encourages believers to seek fullness in the Spirit rather than excess in wine (Ephesians 5:18). Together, these verses call Christians to exercise self-control and pursue holiness rather than the fleeting allure of intoxication.
